name: coding-agent-config
description: Host SoT for shared coding-agent skills, MCP, and (non-portable) hooks/rules on this lab GPU host. Portable Agent Plugins core: skills/ + mcp.json. Everything else is host wiring.

com.emanuele.coding-agent-config.notes: Hooks, subagents, slash workflows, and AGENTS.md are outside Agent Plugins v1 portable core. Clients discover skills/ and mcp.json; install.py still farms them into per-platform paths until clients load this directory as a plugin natively.
